entities.summary: Tommy Emmanuel (b. 1955-05-31, Muswellbrook) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Muswellbrook and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
